text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you seem busy lately. I can 
see the fatigue on your face, too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I put together a 
schedule centered around self-directed 
training? We can discuss and fine-tune the 
details together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Right, we also need to organize the 
paperwork. If we can visually sort the 
tasks, there'll be no need to rush. And 
also—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please don't carry everything on your own. 
Let us both maintain peak condition and 
head toward our goal together.
